name: Kensuke Nakamura
source:
As a certified first aid instructor employed at the nearby hospital, Kensuke Nakamura is charged with training the staff at Yamaku Academy on how to best respond to medical emergencies among the student body.

Since nearly every student at Yamaku has their own medical needs, Nakamura takes his job very seriously.
